observations: Two Porsche V8 engines are shown in a garage or workshop.
The engine on the left has a silver valve cover with 'PORSCHE' and 'V8' embossed on it.
The engine on the right has a black valve cover with 'PORSCHE' and 'V8' embossed on it.
The central part of the engine is a large black airbox with red markings.
The engines appear to be used, with some dirt and wear visible on the components.
A watermark 'EZE PORSCHE GLOBAL AUTOS' is present on all photos.

claims.claim: all kinds of car spare parts

risks.risk: The engine may not be a Porsche or may be a different brand/model.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the valve cover or engine block).

risks.risk: The engine may be a different model than the seller claims (e.g., 3.6L vs 4.0L).
risks.proof: A photo of the engine identification plate.
risks.if_unproven: as the lowest-spec model in the same series

risks.risk: The engine may be missing essential components like the crankshaft pulley or oil pan.
risks.proof: A photo of the engine with the crankshaft pulley and oil pan installed.
risks.if_unproven: as a bare engine without pulley and pan

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the engine identification plate (usually on the valve cover or engine block).
Photo of the crankshaft pulley and oil pan to confirm the engine is complete.
response.reason: The item is clearly a Porsche V8 engine, so it can be priced at its worst case as a used engine of this type.
